description: This source file is the code-behind for a web page displaying a leaderboard in an online examination system. It manages user session validation, database interaction to retrieve user information, and navigation between pages.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: Partial class for the Leaderboard web page, inheriting from System.Web.UI.Page, handling page load and user interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, checks user session, fetches user semester info from database, and populates session variables.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Empty event handler for leaderboard button click, currently does nothing.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by clearing session and redirecting to login page.
